source_snapshot.procedure: Reads, writes, IOPS and measurements on detected NVMe SSDs.

old_problem: Detected SSDs is unsafe: no disposable namespace allowlist, data policy, FIO jobs, thresholds or recovery; Criteria are unrelated.
disposition_reason: SSD FIO purpose is identifiable and ED-04 permits a parameterized case only with a proven disposable allowlist. OS/boot/mounted/RAID/unknown devices remain hard runtime blockers.
decision_basis: Preserved read/write/IOPS coverage while adding strict storage protection.

test_case.purpose: Run the approved read/write/IOPS job only on explicitly disposable NVMe namespaces and verify performance, integrity and health.
test_case.test_command: Perform read-only inventory and refuse any unsafe/unknown target; require explicit destructive approval for exact serial/namespace; run signed job; capture FIO/SMART/kernel/BMC evidence; never auto-select detected SSDs.
test_case.expected_result: Only allowlisted disposable namespaces are touched; full job meets signed performance/integrity/health limits with no collateral change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output/FW, unsafe target or missing threshold cannot PASS.
test_case.recovery: Stop writes immediately on anomaly, preserve logs, remove test data only on confirmed disposable target and follow SSD recovery plan.

source_conflict.reason: FIO performance/integrity controls acceptance; readability/FW remain auxiliary.

blocked.reason: Review method is safe only with runtime storage gates.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind disposable target, signed job, thresholds, authorization and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; DESTRUCTIVE RUNTIME AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED

project_authority: Disposable targets and performance limits are project-specific.
